Its position east of the Liverpool-side corridor in the Northern Territory is compatible with the Blyth River geographic candidate. Figure 13.22 supplies a Blyth River basin callout, but no legible direct Blyth river-line label or named station tied to this selected path was established in the inspected maps. The available-source and complete-path review is complete; representative naming remains on hold. Upper feeder names, exact intermediate name transitions and tidal or coastal parts remain unassigned.
